node.name: Brazilian Lemonade
node.description: This Brazilian Lemonade is crisp and refreshing. It has a unique flavor and texture and makes for a very exciting summer party drink!
recipeIngredient: 1 Tbsp lime zest (from 1 of the limes)
1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk Ice to serve

recipeInstructions.text: Stir together 7 cups cold water with 3/4 cup sugar and set aside.
recipeInstructions.name: Stir together 7 cups cold water with 3/4 cup sugar and set aside.

recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 Tbsp lime zest add juice from 5 limes into your blender jar (it's super fast to juice limes if you have a citrus squeezer like this one). Pour 3 cups of your sugar water into the blender (I only add 3 cups at this time so my blender doesn't splash all over the place).
recipeInstructions.name: Add 1 Tbsp lime zest add juice from 5 limes into your blender jar (it's super fast to juice limes if you have a citrus squeezer like this one). Pour 3 cups of your sugar water into the blender (I only add 3 cups at this time so my blender doesn't splash all over the place).

recipeInstructions.text: Add 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk. Blend until smooth and frothy. Stir in remaining sugar water and serve over ice.
recipeInstructions.name: Add 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk. Blend until smooth and frothy. Stir in remaining sugar water and serve over ice.

review.reviewBody: I just made this and it was amazing! My question is, can you use lime juice instead of fresh squeezed limes?
This is really good! I found myself googling condensed sweetened milk ice though....maybe separate serve over ice part
Something different that turned out quite delicious
